title: Vintage Story Wiki manifest
description: vs-manifest.json: what `npm run download` fetches (the vanilla dedicated server and mods) and extra items/blocks `npm run ingest` should always include. Mirrors the VsManifest interface in src/ingest/types.ts; keep the two in sync.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors like VS Code validate and autocomplete the file.

serverBranch.description: cdn.vintagestory.at release channel the server is downloaded from.

serverVersion.description: Vanilla dedicated server version to download, e.g. "1.22.7". Changing it changes the CI cache key, so the next build re-downloads everything.

mods.description: Mods from mods.vintagestory.at to download and ingest alongside the vanilla game. A mod present in Mods/ but missing here is skipped by ingest.

modid.description: The mod's id on mods.vintagestory.at (its modinfo.json `modid`), e.g. "betterruins".

version.description: Release version to pin, exactly as listed on the mod's page (e.g. "0.6.4"). Omit to take the latest release.

includeItems.description: Items/blocks to always give an /items/ page, even when no recipe, drop table, worldgen rule, trade list, or NPC dialogue reaches them (e.g. static translocators). Each entry is a "domain:code" glob matched against every concrete item/block variant code; `*` is a wildcard. Leaving out the "domain:" prefix matches any domain. Ingest warns about patterns that match nothing.

items.description: "domain:code" glob, e.g. "survival:statictranslocator-*". Vanilla items/blocks mostly live in the "survival" or "game" domain; mod content uses the mod's own domain.
